applies_why: The judge text labels the Romans 1:3 link underdetermined because there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, which invokes the explicit-statement inquiry governed by K-C.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse had to be read either as forbidding an explicit-resolution requirement or as merely ordering the weighing after a collision is found.
why: The judge marks the link underdetermined for lack of explicit textual resolution, which is the retired stating-verse test rather than a chain-by-footing assessment.
